findings.title: The corrected contract still defines the retained face from the wrong set, permits D to disappear on recurrence, and leaves physical-active release semantics ambiguous
findings.evidence: The new precedence paragraph correctly admits D from the pre-hold current physical-free classification, but it says 'for each face D = ... state.free' and the retained-system paragraph still defines R as the complement of D and the face free set as all physically nonfixed coordinates minus D. If an implementation stores the reduced free mask in state.free, recomputing that expression makes D empty on the next face. Conversely, 21-minus-D includes current lower/upper-active coordinates. R03 also asserts 'no active release', which can be read as disabling existing KKT release of a physically active coordinate excluded from D, rather than only forbidding BVLS05 from converting or releasing a held direction.
findings.required_fix: Derive admitted D once per natural or selected assembly from the pre-hold physical-current-free classification, preserve that assembly-owned D across all face pivots/refinements, and define every reduced factor face as current physical-free minus D with ascending original-index traversal. Never derive D from an already reduced factor-free mask or repopulate it after a pivot. State same-J retry retention/rederivation from a fresh initial face precisely. Use 21-minus-D only for the full retained representation, not the active-face factor. BVLS05 itself neither activates nor releases held directions; existing KKT behavior for physically active, non-held coordinates remains unchanged. Update R03 accordingly.

findings.title: R05 and R06 do not freeze operands that deterministically reach zero-lambda and positive-lambda refinement
findings.evidence: Both cases name the C01 retained 19-column system and a desired lambda category but omit the independently prescribed residual/RHS, radius, bounds, base, factor/order and expected p0/p1/p2 values needed to force that category. The captured G4 rank certificate proves retained rank 19; it does not prove which lambda/refinement route the revised solver will take. Allowing the candidate to discover operands after execution would be a prohibited result search, and the original G4 matrix may refuse or choose a different route before the intended cardinality assertions.
findings.required_fix: Freeze formula-derived analytic 21-by-19 operands with two separately certified zero held columns, explicit residual/RHS, scales, bounds, radius, lambda category, factor/free/order mapping, and independently calculated p0/p1/p2 expectations for each route. Reuse the closed G4 matrix only for A01 rank/physical linkage; do not make it the oracle for an unproven refinement path.

findings.title: The lifecycle cases overclaim acceptance and do not fully freeze selected-side or mass operands
findings.evidence: L01 names the frozen G4 natural and selected assemblies but does not prescribe the phase/direction seam operands that select the reassembly; obtaining them by running the revised full G4 natural predictor would consume endpoint prerequisites and make the control outcome-derived. L02 calls its below-capacity trial an 'accepted candidate', although setting M below Cliq proves evaluator wetness/recomputation, not nonlinear merit/root/physical acceptance, and leaves the mass unspecified. L03 freezes the dry base at Cliq/2 and full candidate at Cliq, but both trial cases need exact per-occupancy operands and status.
findings.required_fix: For L01, freeze formula-prescribed phase/direction seam operands and exact counts so the selected assembly is exercised directly without running the full G4 predictor or endpoint; the same-J retry/new-base portion may use a bounded analytic evaluator double plus the separately named physical raw assembly. For L02/L03, use domain-admissible/evaluator trial terminology, freeze exact per-occupancy M/H/D operands, and assert all 21 residuals and ordinary validation while nonlinear/root/physical acceptance remains observed, never a fixture premise.

findings.title: The work policy assigns BVLS05 mask work to counters that currently mean refinement or KKT work, and R07's zero-work path is ambiguous
findings.evidence: The contract says to charge mask work to existing scalar/guard work observation, but the existing fields are semantically specific: refinement_scalar_operations/refinement_guard_events, whole_kkt operations/guards, and upward-enclosure operations/guards. Charging role joins, column scans, mask joins, or scatter copies into any of them would silently relabel eligibility work and could consume the wrong refinement cap. Separately, empty D can mean no BVLS05 provenance (a declared default-empty shortcut) or inspected/rejected candidates (which consume eligibility work). R07 expects zero added mask/scatter/factor work without identifying the path.
findings.required_fix: Keep existing numerical/refinement/KKT cap meanings unchanged. Extend the existing WorkObservation structure with explicit BVLS05 role-join, column-entry-test, mask-join, and held base-copy/scatter attempted/completed counters, rather than charging unrelated fields or creating a parallel framework. Freeze per-case deltas and maxima, including refused/ineligible scans. Declare R07 as a no-provenance default-empty identity path if zero eligibility work is intended; keep inspected-ineligible empty-D accounting in R02/R03/A03/A04. Distinguish per-assembly certificate work, per-face factor work, and final base-copy/scatter work.

accepted_policy_portion: The exact-zero structural increment representative is confined to the six named semantic dry-temperature roles and requires finite positive structural area, exact fwet==1, exact zero effective dry area, and complete exact-zero raw and weighted columns after ordinary guards.

Structural-zero anchors, near-full wetness, unexpected zero roles, nonfinite/scaling operands, and unexplained retained dependencies remain outside the relaxation and retain existing typed refusal precedence.
All 21 residual rows, physical equations, both drainage columns, capacity rows, normalizers, scales, bounds, full KKT/root/validation/custody, and the finite-difference stencil remain intact.

Held steps are +0.0, held base-coordinate bits are reconstructed exactly, masks are assembly-owned and distinct from physical masks, and trial candidates recompute wet/dry physics and all 21 residuals.

Natural, selected, and new-base/new-J assemblies derive fresh masks; only an identical admitted same-J radius retry may reuse one. No rank tolerance, pseudoinverse, clipping, damping, fallback, seed perturbation, or result search is authorized.
The closed G4 exact minor/null evidence may support retained rank 19 without rerunning the calculator; it does not supply refinement-route operands.

disposition.scope_note: The remaining fixes clarify the adopted method and frozen controls; they do not require a new numerical policy or physical run.
